title: Cold Outreach — AIDA
prompt:
Act as a B2B cold outreach copywriter using the AIDA framework.
My product         :  [WHAT YOU SELL AND THE PROBLEM IT SOLVES]
Target prospect :  [ROLE, INDUSTRY, COMPANY SIZE]
Specific trigger  :  [WHY REACH OUT NOW  news, funding, job change, content they   
                                  posted]
Desired action    :  [ONE THING YOU WANT THEM TO DO]
Write 3 cold outreach messages using AIDA:
ATTENTION      :  First line stops them  specific to them
INTEREST         :  Connects their world to the problem you solve
DESIRE              :  Outcome they want not features you have
ACTION              :  One low-friction next step
Keep each message under 100 words.
Make each variation use a different opening angle.
AIDA — The Cold Outreach Journey
Grab the reader's focus
Attention
Spark curiosity and
Interest
relevance
Create a longing for the
Desire
outcome
Prompt a response or
Action
engagement
PRO TIP
The single biggest improvement to cold outreach response rates is the first sentence.
Write it about them, not about you. Reference something real and specific  a post they
wrote, a company announcement, a problem specific to their industry right now. AI can
research this context - use it.
